hints.title: Right Interval Condition
hints.text: For each interval, we need the interval with the smallest start point that is greater than or equal to the current end point.

hints.title: Sorting by Interval Start Point
hints.text: Map each start point to its original index. Sort the list of start points to enable fast logarithmic search.

hints.title: Binary Search for Minimum Greater Equal Start
hints.text: For every interval [start, end], search for the first element in sorted starts with start value >= end. If found, record its original index; otherwise, record -1.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Sorting starts takes O(N log N), followed by N binary searches.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs of intervals takes O(N^2) which times out for N = 20000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Auxiliary array of starts with indices enables O(log N) lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Decouple starts with indices and apply binary search.
